evals.name: slice-dr-into-approved-epics
evals.prompt: Using the existing DR/SRS, linked PRD, and completed Use Cases, propose several cohesive Jira Epics that can each be completed in a few two-week sprints. Group related Use Cases by outcome, show the proposed boundaries and traceability, and ask me to approve the grouping before drafting Jira items. Do not call Jira yet.
evals.expected_output: A reviewable Epic proposal grouped by cohesive outcome and bounded to a few sprints, with source traceability and an explicit approval gate before Jira mutation.
expectations: Proposes multiple Epic slices when one DR/SRS contains enough scope for more than one few-sprint outcome.
Groups Use Cases by cohesive outcome and keeps each Epic boundary explicit.
Shows traceability from each Epic to the parent DR/SRS, PRD/JTBD, and included UC-XX IDs.
Asks for explicit approval before drafting or mutating Jira items.

evals.name: write-actor-stories-and-technical-tasks
evals.prompt: After the Epic grouping is approved, create the Jira backlog projection for UC-01 and UC-02. UC-01 has primary actor "Cittadino pagatore" and UC-02 has primary actor "Operatore di assistenza". Write actor-facing Stories using exactly "As [Actor], I want to [action], so that [Gain]". Keep each Story deliverable in one two-week sprint. Put repository setup and API contract wiring into technical Tasks, and link every item to its Epic and source UC/AC IDs.
evals.expected_output: A Jira-ready draft containing canonical actor-facing Stories, sprint-sized scope, technical Tasks for enabling work, and complete hierarchy/traceability.
expectations: Uses the exact actor names supplied by the Use Cases.
Uses the canonical As/ I want/ so that Story structure.
Keeps Stories and Tasks scoped to one two-week sprint or flags work that must be split.
Represents repository setup and API contract wiring as Tasks rather than actor-facing Stories.
Routes concrete Tasks to the repository from the DR/SRS references.repository link.
Links each item to its Epic and one or more source UC-XX or AC-XX IDs.

evals.name: block-incomplete-readiness
evals.prompt: Generate Jira backlog items from a DR/SRS whose PRD has no confirmed owner or KPI, the Use Case has no binary acceptance checks, and RFC-07 is accepted but not propagated into the DR/SRS. Explain what is blocked and identify the gaps. Do not invent values and do not create Jira items.
evals.expected_output: The skill blocks backlog creation, reports each readiness gap and its impact, and does not infer requirements or call Jira.
expectations: Blocks or pauses Jira creation because Definition of Ready evidence is incomplete.
Reports the missing PRD owner and KPI, missing binary acceptance checks, and unpropagated RFC decision.
Does not invent owners, KPI targets, acceptance criteria, or implementation behavior.
Does not create Jira items while material blockers remain unresolved.

evals.name: synchronize-existing-backlog
evals.prompt: Synchronize the existing Jira projection after UC-02 gains a confirmed retry flow. Preserve the existing Epic, UC-02 link, and unchanged AC-UC-02-* identifiers. Add only the new retry acceptance traceability, avoid duplicate issues, show a proposed diff, and wait for explicit confirmation before updating Jira.
evals.expected_output: A non-destructive synchronization proposal that matches existing issues by stable source identifiers, preserves unchanged data, and requires confirmation before updating.
expectations: Matches existing Jira items using stable source links or IDs and does not create duplicates.
Preserves the existing Epic, UC-02 identity, and unchanged acceptance-check IDs.
Adds only the new retry behavior and its new traceability.
Shows a human-readable proposed diff and asks for explicit confirmation before mutation.

evals.name: require-project-context
evals.prompt: Create the Jira projection from a Use Case, but do not provide a Jira project key or enough information to identify the target board. Ask only for the missing Jira context and stop without inventing a project or creating issues.
evals.expected_output: The skill requests the missing Jira project context and stops without making Jira changes.
expectations: Requests the Jira project key or unambiguous target board.
Does not guess a project, issue type mapping, or required custom field.
Does not create or update Jira items before the missing context is supplied.

evals.name: project-open-questions-and-errors
evals.prompt: Project a ready DR/SRS and Use Case into Jira. The DR/SRS records open.item-007 with Blocking: yes (which CAdES verification library to use) and open.item-003 with Blocking: no. The repository is linked as references.repository = github.com/pagopa/ced-portal. UC-01 defines AGREEMENT_EXTENSION_INVALID and AGREEMENT_SIGNATURE_INVALID; UC-02 reuses AGREEMENT_SIGNATURE_INVALID for the same condition. Draft the backlog.
evals.expected_output: A backlog draft where open.item-007 becomes a spike Task that blocks the dependent Story or Task, open.item-003 is recorded as a non-blocking gap, the error-handling Task for AGREEMENT_SIGNATURE_INVALID is created once and linked to both Use Cases, and concrete Tasks target the linked repository.
expectations: Turns open.item-007 (Blocking: yes) into an independent spike Task and makes the dependent item blocked by it.
Records open.item-003 (Blocking: no) as a gap with an owner and no blocking edge.
Creates one error-handling Task for AGREEMENT_SIGNATURE_INVALID, shared by UC-01 and UC-02, instead of duplicating it.
Routes concrete Tasks to github.com/pagopa/ced-portal from references.repository.
Adds no Task and no link for a non-blocking question, and does not invent the answer to a spike.

evals.name: create-one-prepared-story
evals.prompt: Create a single Jira Story in project PAY for the actor "Cittadino pagatore": as that actor, they want to download the payment receipt, so that they can keep proof of payment. The acceptance check is that the receipt downloads as a PDF. Do not propose Epics or a full backlog. Ask for confirmation before creating anything.
evals.expected_output: A single-item mode flow that normalizes one Story to the canonical contract, asks for any missing field, requests confirmation, and never proposes Epic slicing or a whole backlog.
expectations: Uses single-item mode and does not propose Epic slices or a full backlog.
Writes the canonical As a [Actor], I want to [action], so that [Gain] summary with the exact actor name.
Keeps the Story scoped to one two-week sprint.
Asks for missing fields such as the parent Epic, labels, or source IDs instead of inventing them.
Requests explicit confirmation before creating the item.

evals.name: update-single-item-by-key
evals.prompt: Update the existing Jira Story PAY-42 to add the acceptance check that the receipt is also available from the payment history page. Preserve its actor, summary, parent, and existing acceptance checks. Show the proposed diff and wait for explicit confirmation before updating.
evals.expected_output: A single-item update that matches the issue by the supplied key, changes only the requested acceptance check, shows a field-level diff, and requires confirmation before mutation.
expectations: Matches the existing item using the supplied Jira key rather than creating a duplicate.
Adds only the new acceptance check and preserves the actor, summary, parent, and existing acceptance IDs.
Shows a field-level proposed diff and waits for explicit confirmation before updating.
Re-fetches and verifies the updated item after mutation.

evals.name: validate-cross-domain-delivery-coverage
evals.prompt: Using municipal-planning.md and its approved Epic grouping, prepare an offline Jira preview for project SERV: two outcome Epics, a resident subscription Story, an operator publication Story and a notification-delivery Task. Write backlog.md with the item descriptions, coverage audit and final review. Stop before Jira mutation.
evals.expected_output: A cross-domain Jira projection where every Epic, Story, and Task has Source, Slice Scope ID, observable Output, item-local Checks, and optional AC Coverage IDs; projection keys are unique, evidence shows coverage passing for UC-01:: and UC-02::, and no Jira mutation occurs.
expectations: Uses unique projection keys beginning with UC-01:: or UC-02:: for Use Case delivery slices.
Gives every Epic, Story, and Task the fixed Source, Slice Scope ID, Output, and Checks sections in order.
Lists only stable AC IDs in AC Coverage and never copies acceptance-check text.

Applies the read-only validate-delivery-coverage procedure in references/delivery-coverage.md and shows one evidence row per item plus coverage rows for both UC-01:: and UC-02:: prefixes. This is a documented procedure, not a required executable command.
Keeps item-local Checks distinct from canonical acceptance-check satisfaction and does not paraphrase Given/When/Then behavior.
Does not reuse CED, signed-agreement, CAdES, Practice, or Document assumptions and does not mutate Jira.

evals.name: audit-legacy-delivery-coverage
evals.prompt: Audit the Jira draft legacy-backlog.md against municipal-planning.md in read-only mode. Write backlog-audit.md with evidence for every dispatchable item and selected Use Case. Do not repair the backlog, persist Jira, or change the sources.
evals.expected_output: A truthful failing delivery-coverage audit of the four legacy items and both UC prefixes, not a repaired draft disguised as an audit.
expectations: Reports FAIL for the current legacy draft because Projection Keys and required item sections are absent.
Shows separate evidence rows for EPIC-01, STORY-01, STORY-02 and TASK-01, not only an aggregate count.
Shows UC-01:: and UC-02:: coverage rows and distinguishes narrative AC references from valid structured AC Coverage.
Keeps the supplied canonical source URLs usable and does not claim that all source URLs are absent.
Leaves legacy-backlog.md and municipal-planning.md unchanged and performs no Jira mutations.

evals.name: digest-confirmation-and-epic-remote-link
evals.prompt: A complete backlog projection has passed validate-delivery-coverage. Show the final review for project SERV, including its digest, then wait for an explicit confirmation bound to that digest. The canonical DR/SRS is https://example.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SERV/pages/123/service-status-design-review. If the source changes after confirmation, handle it safely. Describe the persistence verification requirements.
evals.expected_output: A non-mutating review bound to a projection digest; source or projection changes invalidate confirmation; persistence requires the Epic remote link to the canonical DR/SRS and post-write verification of links, identities, and coverage.
expectations: Shows the project, operations, item count, hierarchy, material changes, delivery-coverage result, unresolved gaps, and exact projection digest before mutation.
Treats confirmation as valid only for the reviewed digest and invalidates it when canonical sources or projection content change.

Defines the versioned deterministic JSON serialization and SHA-256 manifest input, including complete write payloads, relationships, remote links and canonical-source content hashes; does not invent a digest when required inputs are unavailable.
Requires every Epic to receive a remote link to the canonical DR/SRS URL.
Requires re-fetch and verification of hierarchy, dependency direction, remote links, unique projection keys, and UC-prefix coverage.
Does not mutate Jira before an explicit confirmation for the current digest.

evals.name: reject-story-without-item-local-ac-coverage
evals.prompt: Audit story-coverage-gap.md in read-only mode. Assess the item contracts and UC-01 coverage separately. Write story-coverage-audit.md. Do not repair the draft or mutate Jira.
evals.expected_output: A failing item-level audit for STORY-01 because its Use Case source requires non-empty AC Coverage, even though TASK-01 covers the complete UC-01 AC set. The aggregate AC mapping does not make the Story valid.
expectations: Reports STORY-01 as FAIL specifically for missing non-empty AC Coverage.
Recognizes that TASK-01 covers AC-01 and AC-02 without treating its coverage as a substitute for the Story's coverage.
Reports overall FAIL even if the aggregate UC-01 AC mapping is complete.
Does not repair the source draft, invent missing requirements, or mutate Jira.

evals.name: preview-standalone-epic-without-upstream-dr
evals.prompt: Prepare the single self-contained Epic described in standalone-epic.md for review, without querying or mutating Jira. Write standalone-epic-preview.md. Do not produce a requirements backlog.
evals.expected_output: A single-item Epic preview that preserves the supplied source and output without requiring an invented DR/SRS, PRD, JTBD or Use Case. Any unavailable Jira field mapping remains a persistence gap; the applicable source link is retained.
expectations: Uses single-item mode and prepares exactly one Epic rather than decomposing a backlog.
Does not require a canonical DR/SRS remote link or upstream PRD/JTBD/UC documents for this self-contained intake.
Keeps the supplied source ID, source link, observable output and binary local check.
Requires explicit digest-bound confirmation before mutation and leaves unavailable Jira schema discovery as a gap rather than inventing field values.
Does not query or mutate Jira.
